name: list_tabs
description: List open eKool browser tabs (id, title, url, active). Use the id as tabId in other tools when several eKool tabs are open.

name: navigate
description: Open a URL in the eKool tab (only ekool.eu addresses are allowed) and wait for it to load. Opens a new tab if no eKool tab exists.

name: snapshot
description: Read the current eKool page: URL, title, visible text, the tables on the page (with refs) and the interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, selects) each with a ref. Always call this first and again after the page changes; refs from older snapshots may stop working.

name: read_table
description: Read a table or grid on the page (for example the class journal) as header labels plus rows. Editable cells come with a ref, their current value and, for dropdowns, the allowed options. Without table_ref, reads every visible table.

name: bulk_set_attendance
description: Fill the same mark (for example an absence code) for many pupils across many lessons in one go. Finds each pupil's row by name (accent- and order-insensitive, so 'Kask Jüri' matches 'Jüri Kask') and sets every editable lesson cell in that row, optionally only the columns whose header contains one of `columns` (for example a date like '04.11' or a lesson number). Cells that already hold a different value are left alone unless overwrite is true. Use dry_run first to preview. This changes the form on screen only; it does NOT save. Reports pupils not found or matched ambiguously.

mark.description: Value to put in each cell, matched against dropdown option values/labels (for example 'P' or 'puudus')

columns.description: Only fill columns whose header contains one of these strings. Omit to fill all editable columns.

table_ref.description: Limit to one table (ref from snapshot/read_table)

name: click
description: Click an element by ref (preferred) or by its visible text. Do not click save/submit/send/delete buttons unless the teacher asked for that.

text.description: Visible label to click if no ref

name: fill
description: Type a value into a text input, textarea or editable field (replaces the current content).

name: select_option
description: Choose an option in a dropdown by option value or visible label.

name: wait_for
description: Wait until some text appears on the page (for example after saving or opening a dialog).
